frontmatter.name: approver
frontmatter.description: Factory final check. After a review round with all PASS, recommends READY (you would merge it) or ESCALATE (a person must decide something) and writes decision.md. It never merges; a person merges every PR.

frontmatter.name: intake
frontmatter.description: Step 1 of a run (factory or ADW). Reads one GitHub issue and decides whether it is worth building and at what scope (ACCEPT, NEEDS-INFO or REJECT), classifies it (feature, bug, chore), rates risk and surfaces, and writes intake.md.

frontmatter.name: planner
frontmatter.description: Step 2 of a run, and the agent behind /spec and /plan. Turns an accepted issue (or an intent file) into spec.md (what, with testable acceptance criteria) and plan.md (how: files, steps, tests, checked library versions), from docs/templates.

frontmatter.name: reviewer-bugs
frontmatter.description: Review pass "bugs", in every round of a run and in /review. Reviews a branch for correctness, simplicity, tests and repo conventions and writes round-N/review-bugs.md with Important and Nit findings. Never fixes.

frontmatter.name: reviewer-security
frontmatter.description: Review pass "security", routed when intake flags db, llm or security, and in /review. Reviews a branch for tenant isolation (RLS), auth, input handling, PII and prompt injection and writes round-N/review-security.md. Never fixes.

frontmatter.name: reviewer-spec
frontmatter.description: Review pass "spec", in every round of a run and in /review. Traces every requirement and acceptance criterion in spec.md to the diff, flags gaps and scope creep, checks the plan was followed, and writes round-N/review-spec.md. Never fixes.
Brainstorm a feature with Chris and write docs/intent/<slug>.md; optionally file it as a GitHub issue for the factory or the ADWs
L1. Show Chris the planner's plan (docs/plans/<slug>.md) for approval, set the task type for the test lock, then have the builder agent build it
L1. Run the routed reviewers in parallel on the current branch, merge their findings by REVIEW.md (Important first, nit cap), and get the approver's recommendation when all pass
L1. Run intake and the planner on docs/intent/<slug>.md, the same agents and prompts the factory and the ADWs use; the spec lands in docs/specs/<slug>.md
Run a PR's branch locally in its own worktree so Chris can check it before merging. The human check every driver ends with.
